title: Report: Giants to release LB Bobby Okereke

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: Giants to release LB Bobby Okereke
sources.description: The Giants have informed linebacker Bobby Okereke that they are releasing him at the start of the league year on March 11, according to Jordan Schultz of The Schultz Report.
